title: The Bastille Day Event — July 2000
description: A major X5.7 solar flare and Earth-directed CME triggered a severe G5 geomagnetic storm and an S3 radiation storm, causing significant satellite anomalies and global radio blackouts.
historicalOutcome: The SOHO satellite was temporarily blinded by a severe solar proton bombardment. Several satellites experienced short circuits and power degradation. High-frequency radio communication was lost over the polar regions for three days.
